description: This is a Java test source file containing unit tests for the EngineChartParser and related classes in the com.rusefi.waves package. The tests validate parsing and processing of engine waveform data, duty cycles, and revolutions.

classes.name: EngineChartParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing EngineChartParser and related waveform processing functionalities

methods.name: testMultiParser
methods.description: Validates parsing of waveform string into EngineChart and checks parsing of crank report data into EngineReport.UpDown list.

methods.name: testDutyCycle
methods.description: Tests parsing of a complex waveform string, revolutions, and duty cycle calculations.

methods.name: testUpOnly
methods.description: Checks parsing of a simple 'up' events string and ensures it is empty as expected.
